label: SEA supplementary documents for international AP applicants

submissionItems.label: Diploma, or current transcript before graduation
submissionItems.note: SEA asks for a current transcript if you have not graduated. A specific predicted-grade form or deadline is not published. Its full-degree guide asks applicants whose diploma arrives after the document deadline to contact SEA; final IB-results acceptance must be agreed.

submissionItems.label: Motivation letter on SEA's mandatory template, with supporting quota 2 documents
submissionItems.note: Use the template linked on the programme page. The quota 2 section requires the letter, though a separate heading calls it recommended; use the required template when submitting one.

submissionItems.label: School-signed subject-hours verification form
submissionItems.note: The programme pages link a stamped, signed form documenting instruction hours over the final three school years. Ask SEA whether the IB subject record suffices instead.

submissionItems.label: English proof unless an exemption applies
submissionItems.note: The full IB Diploma meets the published IB-exam test exemption. Course Results are not expressly covered. The English B subject requirement remains separate.

submissionItems.label: Passport copy and relevant supporting documents
submissionItems.note: Include relevant references, work experience and stays abroad where applicable.

submissionItems.label: Signed signature page when applying without Danish login
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: SEA admissions, as instructed by the portal
submissionItems.note: The full-degree guide requires applicants using its email-based login to send the signed signature page to SEA. It says the Danish-CPR login does not issue this page; follow the current portal signing instructions.

supplementarySteps: Resolve the conflicting international document dates with SEA before applying: FAQ 1 April; full-degree guide EU 5 July/non-EU 1 May. These pages still include a 2026 study-start date, so none of these has been asserted as a confirmed 2027 document deadline.

Arrange how final May-session IB results will reach SEA when they arrive after the published document dates. A current transcript is requested before graduation; neither a dedicated predicted-grade deadline nor automatic acceptance of later final results is published.
Monitor nemStudie for correspondence, the admission decision and instructions for accepting an offer. Full-degree applicants arrange their own housing.

notes: Supplements the national route only for the two SEA AP Opportunities. Scoped milestones supersede unsupported general document, results-delivery and reply assumptions; the national annual March application route remains first and unchanged. No disputed document date is exported as a confirmed 2027 milestone.

milestones.label: SEA: agree the final-document deadline
milestones.note: No unambiguous autumn 2027 deadline is established. The FAQ says 1 April for international exams; the guide gives EU 5 July/noon and non-EU 1 May/noon and asks later-diploma applicants to contact SEA. Obtain the deadline and late-final-IB arrangement from SEA before applying.

milestones.label: Last day to reorder priorities
milestones.note: National annual priority-ordering date, provisional for 2027. This is not SEA's document deadline.

milestones.label: SEA: arrange how final IB results will arrive
milestones.note: Before applying, ask SEA which delivery method and recipient details to use and how final results arriving after its document deadline are handled. A current transcript is requested before graduation; no SEA IB results-service code or automatic late-results permission is established here.

milestones.label: IB May-session results release; SEA delivery must be arranged
milestones.note: The IB release date does not establish SEA's deadline or permission to submit later final results. Follow the document and delivery arrangement agreed with SEA.

milestones.label: SEA: accept by the deadline in your admission letter
milestones.note: SEA says the offer is available in nemStudie and explains the confirmation procedure in the admission letter. No public 2027 reply date is stated; follow your individual offer.
